capabilities: save pasted images to a per-note [document name]__assets folder and hide it
preview Markdown documents as HTML pages with switchable themes
publish documents directly to WeChat Official Account via API
render Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX formulas and Ruby annotation in the preview
copy rendered HTML to content platforms
extras: README is in Chinese. Notes that WeChat servers strip complex LaTeX formulas containing aligned/mtable, image auto-save only works for clipboard pastes, and publishing requires API permissions plus adding your public IP to a whitelist in the WeChat backend.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to prepare notes as styled HTML for Chinese content platforms or to publish directly to WeChat Official Account via its API.

relations.evidence: 参考并使用了其优秀的 Markdown 排版与样式处理逻辑
通过API将文档直接发布到内容平台。目前支持微信公众号

summary: Publishing helper that saves pasted images into per-note asset folders, previews Markdown as themed HTML, and publishes notes to WeChat Official Account.
